component.name: SolveCraft
component.summary: Parametric 3D CAD in the style of Fusion

description.p: This is a community package of SolveCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the SolveCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.

SolveCraft is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application written in Rust. Sketch on a plane, constrain and dimension the sketch, turn profiles into solids on a feature timeline, and change a parameter to watch the timeline rebuild.

ul.li: Sketches with a constraint solver and parameter-driven dimensions
Extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet, chamfer, shell, holes and patterns
Components and joints, sheet metal, and a plastic-enclosure subset
STEP and IGES import and export; 3MF, STL and OBJ
Every action is a command, scriptable from a CLI, a JSON control channel and an MCP server

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=solvecraft-cli ai.storyteller.solvecraft --help

Permissions: this package uses the same sandbox as upstream's own Flatpak manifest: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Documents folder. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.solvecraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.solvecraft
